summary.one_liner: Improving is an enterprise technology services firm offering AI, data, application, and platform engineering work, with 21 offices and a page that markets its consulting and team-staffing engagements.
use_cases: modernize a legacy monolith into cloud-native services
build an agentic AI lead qualification system
train staff on practical AI skills
staff a team with vetted remote engineers
build real-time data streaming for deployments
add semantic search over records using AI
summary.what_it_does: The page is a corporate services page for Improving, not a software tool. It describes consulting engagements in AI-enabled application modernization, DevOps and platform engineering, enterprise integration and APIs, and production support. It lists three engagement models: AI workshops and enablement, managed delivery of AI systems and data platforms, and staffing of vetted engineers across North America, LATAM, and India. It also cites an AI Maturity Model with 8 stages from "Zero AI" to "Agentic Operations". Case examples mention Azure, Google Cloud Vertex AI, and Confluent Kafka work for named clients, but the page gives no technical details of how these were built.
notable: AI Maturity Model with 8 stages of AI adoption, from Zero AI to full Agentic Operations
CodeLaunch: equity-free startup accelerator offering software development to early-stage companies
Free Improving Talks practitioner webinars, held weekly on Wednesdays
Offices across 7 countries and 3 continents hosting community user groups
caveats: Page is mostly marketing; the claimed metrics (NPS, client counts, 98% satisfaction, 60% faster deployment) are unverified and not explained.
Not a downloadable or self-hosted tool; it is a services firm, so engagements require contacting the company.
Pricing for services is not stated on the page.
